notes.title: Now Available - Dream Pinball 3D
notes.content:
Dream Pinball 3D is now available on Steam and is 10% off until September 26th at 10am Pacific Time!

No room for a pinball machine? So what! With DREAM PINBALL 3D you can transform your PC or console into 6 different, multilevel, 3D pinball machines! Clever gameplay, plus balls made of different materials – and each material has special ballistic properties that affect how those balls roll!
